transcript: so my order of society started with religious utopia i chose that because my faith is very important to me and i think that's a good way of living for society then i chose moral commonwealth because i think morals have a lot to do with society and being uh highly successful individuals i think we all need to have morals and a foundation of morals then it comes to rule of law or institutional utopia i say that as third because i think rules should be set in place then i chose the primitivist utopia because i think some things like living off the grid and being low-tech just kind of make things feel a little more natural and then i chose modern green utopia next because i think while i said low tech part of that i think sustainability is important for being eco-friendly and then sixth i chose futuristic futurist utopia i chose that because uh while i am all for low tech being natural more holistic i do think that there is some science behind a lot of things that could help form discoveries and better societies and then last i chose the ai-centered utopia that's my least preferred just because i don't want technology controlling everything
